text: On February 28, 2020, a Zoning By-law Amendment application ("the Application") was submitted to the City for the properties at 110-112 Adelaide Street East and 85 Lombard Street (the "Site") to permit the construction of a 42-storey mixed-use building containing 287 dwelling units, 3288 square metres of office space and 482 square metres of retail space. On April 12, 2024, the applicant submitted a revised Application to permit the construction of a 65-storey mixed-use building containing 600 dwelling units, 330 square metres of office space, and 400 square metres of retail space. On November 7, 2024, the applicant appealed City Council's neglect or failure to make a decision on its Application within the prescribed timelines in the Planning Act to the Ontario Land Tribunal.
